description: Stage 1 arms B1 and B2: the large backbone hfl/chinese-roberta-wwm-ext-large (24 layers, hidden 1024, about 330M parameters; same team, pre-training corpus and vocabulary as the base model, but different depth, width and training details) on the 100 teacher chapters of weak build 20261004-teacher100, setting W (B1, weak S3 labels) or T (B2, Opus teacher labels). B2 - A2 is the effect of swapping the whole backbone (base -> large), not of the parameter count alone; with A1, A2, B1 it forms the labels x backbone 2x2, and B1 - A1 versus B2 - A2 shows whether the swap helps more once the labels are better. Schedule as train_s1_base (about 1300 planned steps over 40 epochs, dev every 2 epochs, patience 6, sufficiency recorded) except: lr 2e-5 (the usual large-model rate; base uses 3e-5), batch 16 reached as 2 micro-batches of 8 with grad_accumulation 2 (the micro losses are weighted by their share of the batch's informative tokens, so the loss and the gradient equal the whole batch's and the schedule is unchanged); the orchestrator measures memory on the RTX 5080 (16 GB) first and may set grad_accumulation to 1 if a batch of 16 fits, which changes nothing but speed. Download approved on 2026-10-04 (1.31 GB, Apache-2.0; `python -m novel_ner.tagger download configs/train_s1_large.json`). Three seeds per arm. Nothing tuned on dev2 or the test.

arms.T: B2 (Opus teacher labels, the same 100 chapters, large)

backbone.download_note: pytorch_model.bin 1,306,484,351 bytes plus small tokenizer files (about 1.31 GB); no safetensors in the repo

grad_accumulation_note: micro-batch 8; set to 1 if the orchestrator's memory test shows a batch of 16 fits on the 16 GB card (same loss and schedule either way)
planned_steps_note: as train_s1_base: about 32 steps per epoch x 40 epochs = about 1300 steps
